reviews.text: I have been bringing my two dachshunds to Regina for almost two years now, and we always leave feeling completely satisfied. She is extremely kind, patient, and very knowledgeable about dogs – it is obvious that she loves what she does. My dogs always come home well-groomed, smelling good, and in a good mood. She is very reliable, precise, and attentive to every little detail. I can only recommend her to anyone who wants the best for their little pet!

We've been going to Regi for a year now, we've been satisfied with his work every time, he's friendly, flexible, a very skilled professional and reliable, so much so that my dog ​​is very timid and yet he's patient with him, which is not an easy case! ❤️ I can only recommend him.

My dog ​​really came out of the beautician very nicely.
The lady must have cut out the lump next to the left ear in an interesting way, because for some reason the dog's skin had torn and it had become infected. If you don't squeeze the scent glands, it's okay...just don't claim you did it. I should note that I didn't invent these, but a veterinarian!!!
We will definitely stay away from this place.

We went here for the first time 1 week ago, our puppy got a thorough cosmetic treatment, which we were very satisfied with! Today we came for ultrasonic tartar removal. Mogi is very kind, he really knows what he does, with full attention and love!🥰 I recommend it to everyone! We will definitely come again!🥰 …
I am completely satisfied, our little Bucika was in the best hands😊 …

Thank you very much for meeting us today. We arrived unexpectedly with Zsepi and Athoska. We actually wanted to make an appointment and find a professional beautician. Of course, there was a recommendation and the very favorable proximity also tempted us, but we got more than that 😊 Since there was still half an hour until the next four-legged friend, we got a quick beautification and graceful scents in addition to the appointment. Thank you for the opportunity and the friendly atmosphere. To be continued! 😊 Zsepi, Athos, Timi, Zoli

I won't go into the story of how many places we've been to... You found the perfect place! Fast, beautiful, kind, friendly, clean. Angie felt comfortable and safe!
Thank you Regina
This is our second time visiting Kozmetika. We love coming here❤️ we always leave feeling pretty and fragrant. I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart.
I am completely satisfied, the dog groomer is very kind and polite, my dog ​​loves it, I always get such a beautiful puppy after the treatment. Thank you very much!

He did a very nice and professional job, I am completely satisfied! The environment is friendly and nice, and the prices are very reasonable. The service was precise and attentive, I will definitely bring my dog ​​here in the future!
Unfortunately, it didn't work for us...the dog's hair was all matted back...and he wasn't very friendly...he's still a beginner...
Thank you very much for what you have done for Negro!

We booked a nail trim at the last minute before Easter at Regi's.
Thank you very much for welcoming us despite your busy schedule. Your attitude, kindness, and experience are top notch! ☺️
Professional work, from a super nice girl.
